channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News, Reddit and more, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: Archiver: Free In-Browser Tool to Extract and Create ZIP, 7z and RAR Archives
item.description: Extract and create ZIP, 7z, RAR and more right in your browser — files never leave your device, with encryption and repair for damaged archives.

item.title: GetRender
item.description: Upload your design and let AI render architectural visuals in seconds, no more waiting in the render queue when you revise a plan.

item.title: Orthosetter: A Deterministic Typesetting Tool for Orthodox Music
item.description: A typesetting tool built for Orthodox church music that turns your scores into consistently formatted sheet music pages.

item.title: RoomDesign Genius
item.description: Upload a photo of your room and get four AI redesigns in your chosen style, plus free in-browser floor plan tools.

item.title: Director's Lookbook, named looks for image, video and music prompts
item.description: Pick a mood and a subject and it hands you a ready-made visual style, with matching image, video and music prompts to copy straight into your AI tools.

item.title: PhotoCraft AI
item.description: A free online PSD editor with an AI agent.

item.title: Celestial Observer
item.description: Enter your birth details to get your Human Design chart instantly, free to generate online — fun to try if you're curious about Human Design.

item.title: PhoEdit
item.description: Free browser-based image and PDF tools — resize, compress, convert, remove backgrounds, no signup.

item.title: AI Detector
item.description: Paste in your text to check for traces of AI writing — simple, free, and online.

item.title: Slitherlinks
item.description: Play Slitherlink online free — 3,000 puzzles, a daily challenge, and no signup.

item.title: BTCMox
item.description: Free crypto research, fee and portfolio-risk tools to check before you trade.

item.title: LinkBit
item.description: A free URL shortener with custom slugs, click analytics, a UTM builder and QR codes that AI agents can also call via API and MCP.

item.title: College Essay Grader – Free AI Score for College Essays
item.description: Paste a college application essay and get a free 100-point score plus six dimension scores, no sign-up needed to see your score.

item.title: FloatSong
item.description: Write royalty-free songs with AI that are ready to use commercially, melody and lyrics in one go.

item.title: MemoTune
item.description: A free AI song generator that produces royalty-free tracks you can use right away.

item.title: Show HN: Prototype of a product management tool for AI agent companies
item.description: Import lost deals, tickets and agent logs as evidence, decide feature by feature what to build, order the roadmap, then track progress and expected impact.

item.title: Show HN: Arbituro
item.description: Hand briefs to AI agents for reports, memos and decks, tidy backlogs and draft schedules — every send or change waits for a human's approval, with a full audit trail.

item.title: Show HN: Cocktail/Mocktail recipe page that's easy to use
item.description: 124 cocktail and mocktail recipes — enter the ingredients you already have and it shows what you can mix, no account needed.

item.title: Show HN: Paste a Link. See the Bias
item.description: Paste a news link and it tells you who owns the outlet, then scores that article's slant from 1 to 7.

item.title: Show HN: Can an AI Agent Bypass Your Website Security?
item.description: Point it at your site and a frontier AI agent tries to break in, then shows you what it managed to do and how risky that is.
